title: 2023 European Video Games Industry Insight Report: Turkey
publisher: European Games Developer Federation (EGDF), with Turkey data attributed to TOGED
methodology: EGDF questionnaire to national associations. It requests FTE employees, entrepreneurs and in-house freelancers of registered game-developer studios and third-party publishers. Remote employees in third countries are allocated to the employer's registered country; foreign subsidiaries and foreign subcontractor companies are excluded. Country-level collection and estimation method are not supplied.
assessment: Primary association-backed source for 10,777. The value is an FTE-oriented, employer-registration measure with an explicitly mixed geography, so it is usable only as the qualified 2023 TOGED snapshot and cannot support a domestic-workplace trend.
access_status: Original PDF downloaded and text/visual chart inspected; decisive PDF and extracted text saved under raw/.
next_step: Obtain TOGED's underlying respondent universe, reference date, and treatment of part-time/contract personnel before treating the value as a domestic workforce census.

title: Türkiye Oyun Geliştiricileri Derneği (TOGED)
methodology: Association website, not a statistical release.
assessment: No dated national employment series or underlying method for the EGDF 2023 submission was recovered in this bounded visit.
access_status: Public homepage fetched; no employment-report evidence located.
next_step: Search TOGED publications, presentations or a direct association disclosure for the source survey/census.

title: Türkiye Oyun Sektörü Raporları
years: 2016-2025 report archive; 2025 reference-year report page updated 2026-02-17
methodology: Publisher's annual ecosystem-report archive. The publisher says its reports compile open-source information with sector knowledge; current 2023-2025 files require an email form.
assessment: The archive establishes that earlier/later editions exist, but it does not itself supply an employment series. The accessible 2021 original was text-searched and contains employment discussion but no national workforce stock. No new observation accepted.
access_status: Primary archive HTML saved under raw/; accessible 2021 PDF inspected separately.
next_step: Use already retained baseline2023/2025 PDFs; recover2016-2020 and2022 originals only if likely to contain workforce tables. No repeat acquisition required for saved editions.

title: Economic activity employment, NACE Rev. 2.1
methodology: TÜİK labour-force employment by economic activity. The associated labour-force release identifies information and communication as a broad NACE section grouping telecommunications, programming, consultancy, IT infrastructure and other information services.
assessment: Official source, but not a games-industry series. The public shell does not expose a game-specific value, and broad software/information codes would include large non-game activity. No observation proposed.
access_status: Public JavaScript application shell fetched and saved under raw/; no game-specific table or code extraction recovered in this bounded pass.
next_step: Use TÜİK microdata or a documented NACE 58.21/62.x establishment tabulation only if it can be obtained with exact code, worker concept and game-specific boundary; do not use section K/J totals as a proxy.

title: TOGED public sitemap
methodology_or_locator: Retrieved 2026-09-19. XML listed 70 public URLs. Each listed URL was fetched with curl using a standard browser user agent; page content was searched for employment terms and 10.777/10777.
assessment: No current TOGED-public national employment observation found. This inventories the published sitemap, not deleted/private/unindexed material.

title: EGDF, How To Enable Digital Growth in Europe?
years: 2015-11-12 (PDF metadata; exact release date not printed) publication, not workforce reference date
methodology: Not stated. The accessible file is a third-party copy of an EGDF-branded publication. PDF p. 4 (printed p. 4), Turkey map label 5,000
assessment: 5000 people working in game development. Publication is dated but the employment reference year and method are not. It conflicts in availability, not necessarily value, with EGDF's later 2018 Turkey N/A entry.

title: TOBB Türkiye Kreatif Endüstriler Meclisi and TOGED, Oyun Ekosistemi Değerlendirme Toplantısı Sonuç Raporu
methodology: Not stated. The report's only described survey is a 15-question live Mentimeter poll of about 52 meeting participants on the proposed law, not employment enumeration (PDF pp. 41-48). PDF p. 5 executive summary; pp. 12-13 (printed pp. 12-13)
assessment: 25000 directly employed people / qualified employment. The report is dated but the workforce reference date, frame, method, cadence and geographic basis are absent.
